intentions.title: Experience brief
intentions.directive: Wonder, discovery, meaningful adventure, everyday belonging, emotionally consequential relationships and an ultimately hopeful possibility of flourishing. Author-fixed experience brief; working and noncanonical.

intentions.title: Victories change the world
intentions.directive: Major victories change the world rather than restore the initial situation. Some conflicts must emerge from consequences of earlier successes. Author-fixed; working and noncanonical.

intentions.title: No escalation; local closure
intentions.directive: No escalating antagonists, arbitrary new threats or indefinitely postponed revelations. Local closure with continuing long-range questions is permitted. Author-fixed; working and noncanonical.

intentions.title: Independent agency across generations
intentions.directive: Several characters, communities or institutions have independent agency. Transformation spans generations. Fresh original concept; do not reuse prior Wandering Islands answers, Book 11 prose or crossing mechanism. Author-fixed; working and noncanonical.
